elements.name: Elf Weapon Training (PHB)
elements.desc: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

elements.name: Fleet of Foot
elements.desc: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

elements.name: Mask of the Wild
elements.desc: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

elements.name: Wood Elf
elements.desc: As a wood elf, you have keen senses and intuition, and your fleet feet carry you quickly and stealthily through your native forests. This category includes the wild elves (grugach) of Greyhawk and the Kagonesti of Dragonlance, as well as the races called wood elves in Greyhawk and the Forgotten Realms. In Faerun, wood elves (also called wild elves, green elves, or forest elves) are reclusive and distrusting of non-elves. Wood elves' skin tends to be copperish in hue, sometimes with traces of green. Their hair tends toward browns and blacks, but it is occasionally blond or copper-colored. Their eyes are green, brown, or hazel. Ability Score Increase: your Wisdom score increases by 1.

elements.name: Dwarven Armor Training
elements.desc: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

elements.name: Mountain Dwarf
elements.desc: As a mountain dwarf, you are strong and hardy, accustomed to a difficult life in rugged terrain. You are probably on the tall side (for a dwarf), and tend toward lighter coloration. Ability Score Increase: your Strength score increases by 2.

elements.name: Superior Darkvision
elements.desc: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

elements.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
elements.desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

elements.name: Drow Magic
elements.desc: You know the dancing lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast faerie fire once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast darkness once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Drow Weapon Training
elements.desc: You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

elements.name: Dark Elf (Drow)
elements.desc: Descended from an earlier subrace of dark-skinned elves, the drow were banished from the surface world for following the goddess Lolth down the path to evil and corruption. Now they have built their own civilization in the depths of the Underdark. With their jet-black skin and white or pale hair, they are often called dark elves. Ability Score Increase: your Charisma score increases by 1.

elements.name: Stout Resilience
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

elements.name: Stout Halfling
elements.desc: As a stout halfling, you are hardier than average and have some resistance to poison. Some say that stouts have dwarven blood. Ability Score Increase: your Constitution score increases by 1.

elements.name: Natural Illusionist
elements.desc: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

elements.name: Speak with Small Beasts
elements.desc: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts. Forest gnomes love animals and often keep squirrels, badgers, rabbits, moles, woodpeckers, and other creatures as beloved pets.

elements.name: Forest Gnome
elements.desc: As a forest gnome, you have a natural knack for illusion and inherent quickness and stealth. In the forests of the world, forest gnomes live in secret, hiding from predators and evil in the deep wood. Ability Score Increase: your Dexterity score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Strength
elements.desc: Your Strength score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Dexterity
elements.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Constitution
elements.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Intelligence
elements.desc: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Wisdom
elements.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human Charisma
elements.desc: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

elements.name: Variant Human
elements.desc: Two ability scores of your choice increase by 1, plus one skill proficiency, one feat and one extra language. Speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Tiefling
elements.desc: Touched by the Nine Hells. +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Infernal Legacy (Asmodeus)
elements.desc: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the hellish rebuke spell once as a 2nd-level spell. Once you reach 5th level, you can also cast the darkness spell once. You must finish a long rest to cast these spells again with this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Bloodline of Asmodeus
elements.desc: The tieflings connected to Nessus command the power of fire and darkness, guided by a keener than normal intellect, as befits those linked to Asmodeus himself. Ability Score Increase: your Intelligence score increases by 1.
